d: Seminal first-contact and alien invasion masterpieces co-authored by Larry Niven and Jerry Pournelle.

coalsack-nebula.x: Yellow G-type star silhouetted like a pinpoint pupil against the dark Coalsack Nebula (The Face of God), enclosing the biological hyper-specialized Motie civilization.
coalsack-nebula.a: motie mote murcheson bury rennie horvath

hip-71683.x: Home system of the herd-mind, trunked alien conquerors the Fithp, who journey across interstellar space aboard the generational mothership Thuktun Fithp.

saturn.x: Outer Solar System arrival and resource-harvesting staging base for the invading Fithp armada before striking Earth.

b.s: The CoDominium empire’s contact with the Moties in the Coalsack Nebula in The Mote in God’s Eye, and the elephant-like Fithp invasion launched from Alpha Centauri in Footfall.
b.r: The Mote in God’s Eye (1974) & Footfall (1985)

a: motie codominium macarthur fithp thuktun orion asteroid michael
